title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
内容提要
这本连环画是根据古典神话小说《西游记》第六十七回编绘的。描述唐僧师徒去西天取经，路过七绝山稀柿同，为当地人们除掉一条作恶的蟒怪。
故事生动有趣，表现了孙悟空勇于降妖除魔，为人们造福的精神。
1 “七绝山上柿树多，秋天结果冬天落，经春过夏全腐烂，石同变成淤泥河。”这座山外貌秀丽，就是常年有一股烂柿臭味，因此，当地人又把它叫做“稀屎同”。
page_text_en:
Content Summary
This illustrated book is adapted from Chapter 67 of the classical mythological novel "Journey to the West". It describes how Master Tang and his disciples traveled to the West to obtain scriptures, passed through Qijue Mountain's Xishi Tong, and eliminated a vicious python demon for the local people.
The story is lively and interesting, showcasing Sun Wukong's bravery in subduing demons and bringing benefits to people.
1 "There are many persimmon trees on Qijue Mountain. They bear fruit in autumn and fall in winter. After spring and summer, they all rot, turning the stone valley into a muddy river." This mountain is beautiful in appearance, but it has a constant smell of rotten persimmons, so the locals also call it "Xishitong".
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《西游记》之二十五《七绝山》的内容提要和第一幅画面，介绍了故事背景：唐僧师徒路过七绝山稀柿同，将为当地除掉作恶的蟒怪，并描述了七绝山因烂柿臭味而得名“稀屎同”的由来。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
2 山东面有个驼罗庄，住着五百多户人家。有一年麦天，正打场，忽然一阵风起，刮得天昏地暗，慌得大家乱嚷：‘雨来了！快拾掇吧……’
3 哪里是雨来了呀，在黄沙弥漫之中，来了一个大妖精！那妖精在庄外吃牛马，进庄吃猪羊，吓得人们关门闭户，谁也不敢露头。
page_text_en:
2 To the east of the mountain there was a village called Tuoluo, where over five hundred households lived. One year during wheat harvest, while they were threshing, suddenly a strong wind blew, darkening the sky and causing everyone to panic and shout: 'Rain is coming! Hurry up and gather everything!' 
3 It wasn't rain at all! In the midst of swirling yellow sand, a huge demon appeared! The demon ate cattle and horses outside the village, and pigs and sheep inside, scaring people into shutting their doors and windows, no one daring to show their face.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了驼罗庄村民在麦收时节遭遇大风，误以为下雨而慌乱收拾，实则是妖怪来袭，妖怪在村内外吃牲畜，吓得村民闭门不出。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
4 妖精不断来闹，人都吓破了胆，不管白天夜里，一听风声就跑。日子不好过，村里管事人商量，公推李老汉到山南去请个和尚来降妖。
5 李老汉真的请来了和尚，在村外搭起布篷。那和尚烧香磕头，摇铃念经，全村的人看了都说：‘老和尚法力无边，降了妖精，这下子可该太平了！’
page_text_en:
4 The demons kept causing trouble, frightening everyone to death. Whether day or night, they would run at the slightest sound of wind. Life became unbearable, so the village leaders discussed the matter and unanimously chose Old Man Li to go to the southern mountain to invite a monk to subdue the demons.
5 Old Man Li really brought back a monk, who set up a tent outside the village. The monk burned incense, knelt, rang a bell, and chanted scriptures. Everyone in the village watched and said: 'The old monk has boundless power, he has subdued the demons, now we can finally live in peace!'
summary_zh: 本页描述了驼罗庄村民因妖怪频繁作乱而生活困苦，公推李老汉去请和尚降妖；李老汉请来和尚后，村民在村外搭篷，和尚烧香念经，村民对此充满希望，认为妖精已被降服。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
6 大家正在高兴，就听一阵风响，妖精又来了。人们乱作一团，一会儿工夫，全跑光了。
7 等外面没了动静，大家才出来看究竟，不料和尚不见了。找来找去，见和尚的那顶帽子挂在树梢上，大家心里明白：和尚被妖精摄走了。从此，人们整天紧闭门户，不敢走出大门。
page_text_en:
6 Everyone was just happy when they heard a gust of wind—the demon had come again. People panicked and scattered, all running away in a short while.
7 After the outside quieted down, everyone came out to see what had happened, only to find the monk was gone. They searched everywhere and found the monk's hat hanging on a tree branch. Everyone realized: the monk had been taken by the demon. From then on, people kept their doors tightly shut and dared not step outside.
summary_zh: 妖怪再次来袭，村民惊慌逃散；事后发现和尚被妖精掳走，仅余帽子挂在树梢，村民从此终日闭门不出。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
8 这天傍晚，李老汉正在家里发愁，忽听有人叫门，他一边向外走一边问：‘是谁？太阳快落了，还出来干什么呀！’
9 门外答道：‘我们是东土差往西天取经的和尚，今晚借宿一宵，万望施主方便方便。’
page_text_en:
8 It was dusk. Old Li was worrying at home when he suddenly heard someone knocking on the door. As he walked out, he asked: 'Who is it? The sun is about to set. What are you doing out here?'
9 From outside, the reply came: 'We are monks sent from the Eastern Land to fetch scriptures from the Western Heaven. We wish to stay for the night. We kindly ask the host to be generous and allow us to stay.'
summary_zh: 李老汉傍晚在家发愁时，听到有人敲门，出门询问后，门外的唐僧师徒自称是东土前往西天取经的和尚，请求借宿一晚。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
10 李老汉开了半扇门，一看是几个和尚，便用手一指说：‘你们要去西天呀？不说别的，就那座七绝山，八百多里长的稀柿同你们就过不去，叫我看呀，打折回吧！’
11 唐僧听了愁容满面。悟空忍不住喝道：‘你这老头儿，有空房就借我们住一夜；实在没有，我们就在树底下蹲蹲也行，你为什么一见面就先吓唬我们呢！’
page_text_en:
10 Old Li opened half the door, saw several monks, and pointed, saying: 'You're going to the West? Forget it. Just that mountain, Qi Jue Mountain, with its eight-hundred-li-long Xi Shi Tong, you'll never get through. In my opinion, turn back!' 
11 Tang Sanzang looked worried. Wukong couldn't help shouting: 'You old man, if you have an empty room, let us stay for the night; if not, we can just squat under a tree. Why do you scare us the moment we meet?'
summary_zh: 李老汉开门见到唐僧师徒，因七绝山稀柿同的险恶劝他们折返；孙悟空听后不满，质问李老汉为何一见面就吓唬他们。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
12. 这时，八戒和沙僧都想搭腔。李老汉一看，吓得倒退了几步，咳嗽了一声，壮着胆子对悟空说：‘你是什么人？怪头怪脑的，敢来冲撞我老人家！’
13. 悟空怕他关门，连忙陪笑道：‘我叫孙悟空，随同师父西天取经。那两个是我师弟，你别看长相不好，我们都有偷天换日的本领，沿路上，我们降的妖，除得怪可真不少呀！’
page_text_en:
12. At this moment, Bajie and Sha僧 both wanted to speak up. Li Laohan, upon seeing them, stepped back a few paces, coughed, and bravely said to Wukong: 'Who are you? You look strange and bizarre—how dare you intrude on my old man's home!'
13. Wukong, fearing he might close the door, quickly smiled and said: 'My name is Sun Wukong. I am traveling with my master to the West to fetch scriptures. Those two are my younger brothers. Don't judge by appearance—we all have the power to change heaven and earth. Along the way, we have subdued many demons and eliminated countless monsters!'
summary_zh: 李老汉见到唐僧师徒后因他们长相怪异而惊惧质问，孙悟空为自证身份并消除其顾虑，主动介绍自己及师弟们西天取经的经历和降妖除魔的本领。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
14 李老汉一听他们能降妖除怪，马上变成笑脸，上前拉着唐僧说：‘怪我有眼无珠，不知道大法师到了，若不嫌寒舍肮脏，就请法师委屈一夜吧！’
15 李老汉给唐僧师徒收拾好住处，又请他们吃夜饭。八戒问悟空道：‘这老头儿刚才不肯留宿，怎么现在待我们这样好呢？’悟空道：‘我想，他一定有用我们之处，说不定，明天还要给我们摆斋哪。’
page_text_en:
14 Old Li, upon hearing they could subdue demons, immediately smiled and rushed forward, grabbing Tang Sanzang and saying, 'I'm sorry for my poor eyesight; I didn't realize the great master had arrived. If you don't mind the humble abode, please stay for the night!' 
15 Old Li tidied up accommodations for Master Tang and his disciples and invited them to have dinner. Bajie asked Wukong, 'This old man refused to let us stay earlier, why is he treating us so well now?' Wukong replied, 'I think he must have a use for us. Maybe tomorrow he'll even prepare a feast for us.'
summary_zh: 李老汉得知唐僧师徒能降妖除怪后，态度大变，热情邀请他们留宿；八戒对此感到疑惑，孙悟空则认为李老汉必有求于他们。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
16 吃罢饭，李老汉又端来茶水，八戒看了，憋不住问道：‘老汉，你对我们这样好，是不是有事要我们替你办呀？’
17 李老汉喜出望外，忙说：‘是，是！是这样，刚才听说你们能降妖除怪，我们这里正闹妖怪，想请你们拿拿……’
page_text_en:
16 After finishing the meal, Old Li brought tea. Seeing this, Bajie couldn't help asking, 'Old man, you're being so kind to us. Is there something you want us to do for you?'
17 Old Li was overjoyed and hurriedly said, 'Yes, yes! It's like this—just now I heard you can subdue demons and monsters. We're having trouble with a monster here. I'd like to ask you to deal with it...'
summary_zh: 八戒因李老汉热情款待而怀疑其有求于己，李老汉随即表明来意，请求唐僧师徒帮忙降服村中妖怪。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
18 八戒一听，直往后退。唐僧也不敢搭话。悟空忙说：
“拿妖怪呀，行。你先说说妖怪是什么样子吧。”老汉便把
妖怪怎么厉害，以及请和尚除妖失败的经过，详细讲了一遍。
19 唐僧听了，又想搭救这一带的百姓，又怕妖怪厉害，
拿不住它。正在为难，八戒却说：“我们是行脚僧，睡一夜，
明天走路，谁管拿什么妖怪呀！”
page_text_en:
18 Pigsy, upon hearing this, stepped back. Tang Sanzang dared not speak. Wukong hurriedly said: 
"Catch the monster? Fine. First, tell us what the monster looks like." The old man then detailed how fierce the monster was, and recounted the failed attempt to have a monk subdue it.
19 Tang Sanzang, upon hearing this, wanted to save the local people, yet feared the monster was too powerful to capture. Just as he was hesitating, Pigsy said: "We are traveling monks. We'll sleep one night, then leave tomorrow. Who cares about catching any monster!"
summary_zh: 李老汉向唐僧师徒详细讲述了妖怪的凶残和请和尚降妖失败的经过，唐僧犹豫是否出手相助，八戒则表示不愿管此事，只想安睡一晚后继续赶路。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
20 李老汉没理八戒，眼巴巴地望着悟空，悟空很爽朗地说：‘不打紧，我去替你们拿来！’喜得李老汉说：‘好，我去找几个管事的，给你们写个文书，降了妖怪，重重酬谢。’
21 不大一会儿，找来八九个老年人，他们一来，先问要多少谢礼，悟空笑道：‘只要有茶饭就行，俗语说“要金银晃眼，要铜钱腥臭”，我们是积德的和尚，分文不要。’
page_text_en:
20 Old Li ignored Bajie, staring eagerly at Wukong. Wukong cheerfully said, 'Don't worry, I'll go get it for you!' Old Li was delighted and said, 'Great, I'll go find a few officials and write you a formal document. Once you defeat the monster, I'll reward you generously.'
21 Shortly after, he brought back eight or nine elderly men. As soon as they arrived, they asked how much reward they would receive. Wukong laughed and said, 'Just tea and food will do. As the saying goes, “Gold and silver dazzle the eyes, copper coins stink of greed.” We are virtuous monks and don't want a single coin.'
summary_zh: 李老汉请求唐僧师徒降妖，孙悟空爽快答应并表示不求报酬，李老汉随即去找村中管事的人写文书，而村中长老们前来商议时，孙悟空表明他们只求茶饭，分文不取。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
22 大家一听不要谢礼，都很高兴。就在这时，外面吹起狂风，吓得众老人齐说：‘哎呀！说妖怪，妖怪就来了！’一个个面无血色，在屋里乱碰乱撞。
23 李老汉开了里屋门，叫大家和唐僧都到套间里躲藏。八戒和沙僧也想跟进去，被悟空一手拉住一个说：‘别走，跟我出去看看是什么妖怪。’
page_text_en:
22 Everyone was happy to hear they didn't need to give thanks. Just then, a strong wind blew outside, frightening the elders who all cried out: 'Oh my! As soon as we mention the monster, the monster has arrived!' One by one, they turned pale and bumped around wildly in the room.
23 Li Laohan opened the inner room door and told everyone and Tang Sanzang to hide in the inner chamber. Bajie and Sha Wujing also wanted to go in, but Wukong grabbed each of them by the arm and said: 'Don't go, come with me to see what kind of monster this is.'
summary_zh: 狂风骤起，村民惊恐以为妖怪来了，纷纷躲藏；孙悟空却拉住八戒和沙僧，执意要出去查看妖怪的真面目。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
24 风头过去，半空中现出两道闪光，悟空喊他俩来看。八戒仰脸一望，笑道：‘是个好妖精，你们看，它夜里走路还打灯笼哩！’
25 沙僧仔细一瞅说：‘你看错了，那是妖精的一对眼睛。’吓得八戒把脖子一缩说：‘我的妈呀，眼睛这么大，那嘴该有多大呀！’
page_text_en:
24 The wind died down, and two flashes appeared in the sky. Wukong called out to the other two to come and look. Bajie looked up and laughed, saying, 'It's a fine demon! Look, it's even carrying a lantern while walking at night!'
25 Sha Wujing took a closer look and said, 'You're wrong. Those are the demon's eyes.' Scared, Bajie pulled his neck in and said, 'Goodness! If the eyes are that big, how big must its mouth be!'
summary_zh: 狂风过后，半空中出现两道闪光，孙悟空让八戒和沙僧观看。八戒误以为是妖精打灯笼，沙僧指出那是妖精的眼睛，八戒吓得缩脖子，惊呼其嘴该有多大。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
26 悟空扯了八戒一把说：‘你别出丑了！快同沙僧去保护师父，待我上去看看到底是什么妖怪。’
27 悟空跳到空中，喝道：‘你是那方妖怪？快快报出名来！’那妖怪不答应，又连问几遍，还是不开口，悟空笑道：‘原来是个又聋又哑的家伙，不要走，吃我一棒！’
page_text_en:
26 Wukong grabbed Bajie and said, 'Don't make a fool of yourself! Quickly go with Sha Wujing to protect the Master. I'll go up and see what kind of monster this is.'
27 Wukong jumped into the air and shouted, 'Which demon are you? Quickly reveal your name!' The monster didn't respond. After asking several more times, it still remained silent. Wukong laughed, 'So you're a deaf and mute fellow. Don't run—take this stick!'
summary_zh: 孙悟空命令猪八戒和沙僧保护师父，自己上前查看妖怪；随后跳到空中喝问妖怪身份，因妖怪不答，便认定其又聋又哑，准备出手攻击。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
28 悟空举棒就打，那妖怪舞枪遮拦。他们一来一往，一上一下，斗到三更时分，不见胜败。
29 八戒在下面看得明白，妖怪只守不攻，喜得八戒扛起钉钯说：‘沙僧，你好好保护师父，我去抄妖怪的后路，也领杯酒吃吃。’
page_text_en:
28 Wukong raised his staff and struck, while the demon wielded his spear to block. They fought back and forth, up and down, until the third watch of the night, with no clear winner or loser.
29 Pigsy, watching from below, saw clearly that the demon only defended and did not attack. Delighted, Pigsy shouldered his rake and said, 'Sha Wujing, you protect Master well. I'll go around behind the demon, and then I'll get a drink to celebrate.'
summary_zh: 孙悟空与妖怪激烈交战至三更，不分胜负；猪八戒见妖怪只守不攻，便自告奋勇要去抄妖怪后路，顺便领酒吃。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
30 八戒跳上云头，找了一阵，也找不到妖怪的后背，气得他举钯就打。那妖又使一条枪抵住，两条枪尖，弯弯曲曲，可长可短，左右灵活，悟空的棒和八戒的钯都伤不着它。
31 八戒叫道：‘猴哥，这妖的软柄枪可真难破呀。’悟空说：‘它还不会说话哩，想是还未归人道，天亮阳气一胜，它必要走，那时，一定赶上，不要放它。’
page_text_en:
30 Pigsy jumped onto the clouds, searched for a while, but couldn't find the monster's back. Angry, he raised his rake to strike. The monster then used a spear to block, its two spear tips twisting and turning, able to extend or shorten, moving flexibly left and right, making it impossible for Wukong's staff and Pigsy's rake to hit it.
31 Pigsy called out: 'Monkey Brother, this monster's flexible spear is really hard to break!' Wukong said: 'It still can't speak, probably not yet fully human. When the sun rises and yang energy prevails, it will surely flee. At that time, we must catch up and not let it escape.'
summary_zh: 猪八戒试图从后方攻击妖怪但未能得手，妖怪的软枪灵活难破；孙悟空判断妖怪尚未完全化形，决定天亮后追击。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
32 又斗多时，果然那妖一听鸡叫，回头就跑。悟空和八戒早有准备，紧紧跟上。
33 赶了一阵，忽然一股臭味难闻，八戒叫道：‘好臭！好臭！想是到了那老汉说的稀屎洞了吧？’悟空喝道：‘别废话，快赶妖怪吧！’
page_text_en:
32 After fighting for a while longer, the demon, upon hearing the rooster crow, turned and fled. Wukong and Bajie, who had been prepared, quickly followed.
33 After chasing for a while, suddenly a foul smell became unbearable. Bajie cried out: 'Stinks! Stinks! Could this be the dung pit the old man mentioned?' Wukong shouted: 'Stop talking nonsense, hurry and chase the demon!'
summary_zh: 孙悟空和猪八戒追赶妖怪，妖怪在鸡叫后逃跑，二人紧追不舍；途中闻到恶臭，八戒猜测是老汉所说的稀屎洞，孙悟空催促继续追赶。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
34 那妖窜过山去，现了本相，原来是一条红鳞大蟒。
35 八戒一看，打了个寒噤说：“好家伙，要吃人，一顿五百个也不够呀，师兄，快打！”悟空纵身赶上，照头一棒，那妖一头钻进窟里，还有七八尺长的尾巴拖在外边。
page_text_en:
34 The demon darted over the mountain, revealing its true form — a huge red-scaled python.
35 At a glance, Eight-Precepts shivered and said, “Goodness, it’s going to eat people — even five hundred at a meal wouldn’t be enough! Brother, hurry and strike!” Wukong leaped forward and swung his staff at its head. The demon plunged into a cave, leaving a tail seven or eight feet long dragging outside.
summary_zh: 妖怪现出原形，是一条红鳞大蟒；猪八戒惊呼其凶猛，孙悟空追击并一棒击中，妖怪钻入洞中，仅尾巴外露。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
36 八戒放下钉钯，拉着蟒尾巴，尽力往外乱扯。悟空笑道：‘呆子！窟窿拔蛇，哪能拉得出来呀，快撒手，我有办法叫它出来。’
37 八戒一松手，蟒却钻了进去。悟空说：‘这蟒在窟里不能转身，一定有个后门，你去后门堵住，我在这里打。’八戒连说：‘对，对。’说罢，一溜烟跑往山后去了。
page_text_en:
36 Pigsy put down his rake and pulled hard on the snake's tail, trying to drag it out. Wukong laughed: 'Fool! You can't pull a snake out of a hole like this. Let go, I have a way to make it come out.'
37 As soon as Pigsy let go, the snake slithered back in. Wukong said: 'This snake can't turn around in the hole; there must be a back entrance. You go block the back door, and I'll fight here.' Pigsy kept saying: 'Right, right.' Then he dashed off towards the back of the mountain.
summary_zh: 猪八戒试图拉出钻入洞中的蟒蛇未果，孙悟空劝他放手并计划由自己在洞口攻击，让八戒去堵住洞的后门，八戒随即跑往山后执行任务。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
38 八戒刚找到蟒的后门，正向里瞅哩，没想到悟空在前门用棒一捣，那蟒一阵剧疼，猛地窜出去，八戒闪躲不及，被蟒尾巴甩开三丈多远，跌了个嘴啃泥。
39 八戒忍住疼，刚刚爬起，只见悟空跑来吆喝：‘快赶妖怪！’八戒跌得头昏脑胀，又怕悟空笑他，便强打精神，举起钉钯乱扑一阵。
page_text_en:
38 Pigsy had just found the snake's rear entrance and was looking inside when, unexpectedly, Wukong struck the front with his staff. The snake felt intense pain and suddenly lunged out. Pigsy couldn't dodge in time and was flung over three zhang by the snake's tail, falling face-first into the mud.
39 Pigsy gritted his teeth and just got up when he saw Wukong running over and shouting, 'Hurry and chase the monster!' Pigsy, dazed and dizzy from the fall, and afraid of being laughed at by Wukong, forced himself to rally his spirit and swung his rake wildly.
summary_zh: 猪八戒在堵住蟒蛇后门时，被孙悟空从正面击中蟒蛇导致其突然窜出，八戒被尾巴甩飞摔倒；他忍痛爬起后，被孙悟空催促继续追赶妖怪，便强打精神挥舞钉耙攻击。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
40 悟空笑道：‘活呆子，妖怪跑了，你还扑什么呀，快赶吧！’八戒这才清醒过来，做了个鬼脸说：‘我老猪在这里打草惊蛇哩！’
41 赶过涧去，见那蟒盘成一团，翘着头张着嘴，要吞他俩。悟空一个跟斗跳到那怪嘴边，那怪像老虎吃羊羔一样，便把悟空吞了下去。八戒吓得撒腿便跑。
page_text_en:
40 Wukong laughed: 'You silly pig, the monster has run away, why are you still pouncing? Hurry up!' Bajie finally came to his senses, made a grimace, and said: 'I, Old Pig, am here stirring up the grass to scare the snake!' 
41 They rushed across the ravine and saw the python coiled up, lifting its head and opening its mouth, ready to swallow them both. Wukong did a somersault and jumped to the monster's mouth. The monster, like a tiger eating a lamb, swallowed Wukong whole. Bajie was terrified and ran away immediately.
summary_zh: 孙悟空嘲笑猪八戒在妖怪逃跑后仍傻乎乎地扑打，猪八戒自嘲是在打草惊蛇；随后二人追至涧边，蟒蛇张口欲吞他们，孙悟空跳入其口被吞下，猪八戒吓得逃跑。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
42 八戒正在为悟空担心，忽然，见那妖怪猛地窜上空中，接着又“扑通”一声跌落在地上，变成直棍一条，一动也不动了。
43 八戒赶来举钯要打，悟空从蟒嘴里钻出来笑道：“蟒已经被我打死了，快拖回去让他们看看吧。”
page_text_en:
42 Pigsy was worried about Wukong when suddenly he saw the monster dash into the air, then 'plop' fall to the ground, turning into a straight stick, motionless.
43 Pigsy rushed over to swing his rake, but Wukong emerged from the python's mouth, laughing: 'The python is dead. Quickly drag it back so they can see.'
summary_zh: 妖怪被孙悟空击中后从空中跌落，变成直棍不动；猪八戒赶来欲打，孙悟空从蟒蛇口中钻出，声称已将其打死并让猪八戒拖回。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
44 再说那驼罗庄的管事人，等了一夜不见悟空和八戒回来，都很担心。唐僧说：‘大家放心，他二人都有本领，不会出危险，我们出庄看看吧。’
45 众人刚出庄，只见悟空和八戒拖着一条大蟒，高高兴兴地回来了。
page_text_en:
44 Meanwhile, the managers of Tuoluo Village, having waited all night without seeing Wukong and Bajie return, were very worried. Tang Sanzang said, 'Everyone, don't worry. They both have skills and won't be in danger. Let's go out of the village to take a look.'
45 As soon as everyone left the village, they saw Wukong and Bajie dragging a huge python, returning happily.
summary_zh: 驼罗庄的管事人因不见孙悟空和猪八戒归来而担忧，唐僧安慰众人并提议出庄查看；众人刚出庄，便见悟空和八戒拖着一条大蟒，高高兴兴地回来了。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
46 只一会儿工夫，消息传开了。全庄男女老幼都出来看妖怪，真是人人感激，个个欢喜，驼罗庄霎时有了生气，到处都唱起欢乐的歌。
47 驼罗庄的人，都知道唐僧师徒不要钱物，便东家请酒，西家摆席，一直留他们住了七天。
page_text_en:
46 In just a short while, the news spread. Men, women, and children from the entire village came out to see the demon. Everyone was grateful and joyful; Tuoluo Village suddenly came alive, and joyful songs rang out everywhere.
47 The people of Tuoluo Village knew that Master Tang and his disciples did not want money or goods, so one household would invite them for wine, another would set a feast, and they were kept there for seven days.
summary_zh: 驼罗庄的村民得知妖怪被除后纷纷出来围观，全村欢庆；因唐僧师徒不收钱财，村民热情款待，留他们住了七天。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
48 唐僧师徒临走那天，全庄七八百人都来欢送。他们抬着干粮果品，一路欢欢喜喜，一直送到七绝山稀柿同口。
49 唐僧一看山路全被烂柿填塞，好像淤泥，恶臭难闻。要悟空想办法，悟空也很为难。李老汉看了忙说：‘我们早商量好了，为了报答你们的恩情，我们要另开一条路，送你们过去。’
page_text_en:
48 On the day Tang Sanzang and his disciples were leaving, seven or eight hundred people from the entire village came to see them off. They carried dry food and fruits, happily accompanying them all the way to the entrance of Qijue Mountain, Xishi Tongkou.
49 Tang Sanzang looked at the mountain path, which was completely blocked by rotten persimmons, resembling mud and smelling terrible. He asked Wukong to find a solution, but Wukong was also at a loss. Old Man Li, seeing this, hurriedly said, 'We've already discussed it. To repay your kindness, we will open a new path and send you through.'
summary_zh: 唐僧师徒离开驼罗庄时，全村人欢送至七绝山稀柿同口；因山路被烂柿堵塞，李老汉表示将另开新路送他们过去。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
50 悟空笑道：‘老汉，是你说的，这座山八百多里。你们又不是神兵，修条山路，要等到何年何月呀？’
51 唐僧急问：‘那可怎么办呢？’悟空说：‘路是能开，只怕没人管饭。’李老汉忙说：‘长老说那里话，只你们四位，就是住上半年八个月，我们也管得起呀……’
page_text_en:
50 Wukong laughed: 'Old man, you said it yourself, this mountain is over eight hundred li. You're not divine soldiers, how long will it take to build a road?'
51 Tang僧 urgently asked: 'Then what shall we do?' Wukong said: 'The road can be opened, I just fear no one will provide meals.' Li Laohan hurriedly said: 'Master, don't say such things. Just you four, even if you stay for half a year or eight months, we can afford to feed you...'
summary_zh: 孙悟空嘲笑李老汉开山路耗时太久，唐僧询问对策，孙悟空表示开路可行但担心无人供饭，李老汉则热情表示愿意长期款待师徒四人。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
52 悟空说：‘既然如此，你们就快取干饭、馍馍来，让我们这位长嘴和尚吃饱了，变个大猪，拱开稀柿同我们就能过去了。’
53 八戒嫌脏不干。唐僧说：‘悟能呀，你真能拱开条路，这回记你头功。’八戒听了得意地说：‘俺老猪变轻巧的不会，变笨大的倒行，快拿干饭、馍馍来吧，吃够了才好干活儿！’
page_text_en:
52 Wukong said: 'If so, quickly bring dry rice and buns, let our long-mouthed monk eat his fill, turn into a big pig, and root through the rotten persimmon path so we can pass.'
53 Bajie was reluctant to do it, finding it dirty. Tang僧 said: 'Wuneng, if you can really root out a path, this time I'll credit you with the first merit.' Bajie, pleased, said: 'I can't turn into something nimble, but I can become big and clumsy—quick, bring dry rice and buns, I need to eat my fill before I can work!'
summary_zh: 孙悟空提议让猪八戒吃饱后变大猪拱开被烂柿堵塞的山路，猪八戒起初嫌脏不愿干，但在唐僧夸奖后欣然同意，要求先吃饱再干活。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
54 大家把抬来的干粮、果品、烧饼、馍馍都摆上，八戒满心欢喜，脱去衣服丢掉钯，边吃边说：‘施主们别笑话，看我老猪的本事吧！’
55 八戒吃饱喝足，把身子一摇，马上变个大猪，四只白蹄千尺高，好像一座小山，大家看了都称赞不止。
page_text_en:
54 Everyone laid out the dry food, fruits, baked buns, and steamed buns they had brought. Eight-Immortal was overjoyed, took off his clothes, threw away his rake, and while eating, said: 'Don't laugh, masters, watch my old pig's skills!' 
55 After eating and drinking his fill, Eight-Immortal shook his body and instantly turned into a giant pig. His four white hooves were a thousand feet high, looking like a small mountain. Everyone watching praised him endlessly.
summary_zh: 猪八戒在村民的款待下吃饱喝足，随后变身为一头巨大的猪，引得众人称赞。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
56 八戒在前面拱路，悟空和沙僧扶持师父随行；驼罗庄的人们轮流运粮。不几天工夫，八百里的稀柿同被老猪拱开一条大道。
57 驼罗庄的人坚持送粮，一直送到稀柿同西口，才和唐僧师徒分手。
page_text_en:
56 Pigsy digs the road ahead, while Wukong and Sha僧 support the Master as they follow. The people of Tuoluo Village take turns transporting grain. In just a few days, the eight-hundred-li Xi Shi Tong is cleared by the old pig, opening up a wide road.
57 The people of Tuoluo Village continue to deliver grain, sending it all the way to the western entrance of Xi Shi Tong, before finally parting ways with Master Tang and his disciples.
summary_zh: 猪八戒在前方用嘴拱开被烂柿堵塞的山路，孙悟空和沙僧搀扶唐僧跟随，驼罗庄的村民轮流送粮；几天后山路被打通，村民一直送粮到稀柿同西口才与师徒四人告别。

title_en: Comic Book 'Journey to the West 25: The Seven-Deadly Mountains'
source_file: 连环画《西游记25：七绝山》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
58 从此，七绝山太平了，稀柿同又变成一条人来人往的大路。年年深秋，人们上山去采食柿果的时候，都会想起唐僧师徒降妖开路的好处。欲知后事，请看《计盗紫金铃》。

Every deep autumn, when people went up the mountain to pick persimmons, they would remember the benefits of Tang Sanzang and his disciples subduing demons and clearing the path. To learn what happens next, please read 'The Plan to Steal the Purple Golden Bell'.
